title: Palmly reading narrative (v1)
description: Pass-2 narrative output (Backend §6.3). Structured sections so the client renders native progressive-unlock UI, not a text blob. The claim-bearing fields — section `key`, `depth_level`, `tags`, `feature_refs` — are DETERMINISTIC (code-derived from the stored features via keyed KB lookup, §6.5, §6.6.6); only `headline`, `title`, `body` are model-authored wording. Regenerating from identical features therefore yields identical claims (the diff target) while prose may vary. Stored in readings.narrative.

tags.description: Canonical claim identifiers = the feature_keys grounding this section (e.g. 'heart_line.depth.deep'). The consistency diff target.

feature_refs.description: feature_keys resolved into KB chunks that grounded this section (same set as tags for v1).
